    Bug 1921150 - Port bug 1920802: Workaround for eslint-plugin-no-unsanitized looking for package.json. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D223666

diff --git a/tools/lint/commlint/__init__.py b/tools/lint/commlint/__init__.py
index c1fd414cc3b..8b5d578709d 100644
--- a/tools/lint/commlint/__init__.py
+++ b/tools/lint/commlint/__init__.py
@@ -58,9 +58,15 @@ def _expand_support_files(root, config):
 
 def eslint_wrapper(paths, config, **lintargs):
     comm_root = Path(lintargs["root"]) / "comm"
+    pkg_json = comm_root / "package.json"
+    with open(pkg_json, "w") as fp:
+        fp.write("{}\n")
+
     with pushd(comm_root):
         rv = lint_wrapper(paths, config, **lintargs)
 
+    pkg_json.unlink(missing_ok=True)
+
     return rv
